project: Serverless FHIR Data Pipeline Performance Study
purpose: Define join keys and schema for cohort fact table aggregation

join_table.name: cohort_fact_va
join_table.description: Aggregated performance metrics by data source for Virginia cohort
join_table.grain: One row per data source (nhanes, synthea, vdh, plus ALL aggregate)

data_source.description: Data source identifier for stratified analysis

period_id.description: Month identifier derived from temporal fields (YYYY-MM format)
period_id.join_logic: Used for temporal stratification (optional in cohort_fact_va)

state_abbr.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for geographic stratification

source_id.description: Unique identifier for source file (combination of source + filename)
source_id.join_logic: Row-level identifier in processed data; not used in cohort aggregation

schema_variant.description: Schema version or variant within data source
schema_variant.join_logic: Used for stratified analysis within data sources (not in current cohort_fact_va)

customer_id.description: One-way HMAC hash of Patient.id for privacy-preserving linkage
customer_id.purpose: Enable cross-file patient linkage without storing PHI
customer_id.current_implementation: Not implemented (Synthea patients not linked across files)

low_precision_time.description: Flag indicating temporal field has reduced precision

values.1: Only one temporal field available, or inferred from alternate field

low_precision_time.impact: Records with low_precision_time=1 excluded from month-stratified analyses

ambiguous_geo.description: Flag indicating geographic field inferred or missing

values.1: State inferred from city, or no geography available

ambiguous_geo.impact: Records with ambiguous_geo=1 excluded from VA-specific geographic analyses

lab_oob_na.description: Flag indicating lab observation has no reference range

values.1: No reference range (non-lab vital or missing)

lab_oob_na.impact: Records with lab_oob_na=1 excluded from lab_oob_rate numerator/denominator

nih_geo_limited.description: Flag indicating NIH imaging data lacks state-level geography

values.1: NIH Chest X-ray dataset (no state metadata)

nih_geo_limited.impact: Records with nih_geo_limited=1 excluded from VA join
nih_geo_limited.current_implementation: Not used (NIH images not processed in current pipeline)

aggregation_logic.base_query: SELECT data_source, COUNT(*) as n_records, AVG(latency_sec) as mean_latency_sec, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_sec) as p50_latency_sec, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_sec) as p95_latency_sec, SUM(CAST(validation_passed AS INT)) / COUNT(*) as validation_pass_rate, AVG(file_size_kb) as mean_file_size_kb FROM processed_data GROUP BY data_source

join_operations.description: Group by data_source and calculate aggregates

join_operations.logic: UNION ALL with same aggregates calculated across all data_source values

temporal_stratification.description: Add period_id to cohort_fact_va for time-series analysis

patient_linkage.description: Use customer_id to link records across files
patient_linkage.join_logic: LEFT JOIN processed_data p1 ON p1.customer_id = p2.customer_id
patient_linkage.privacy_note: Requires HMAC key management and IRB approval if using real data
